data.title: Tree felling permit refused
data.summary: The Bezirksamt Musterbek (Hamburg) rejected your application of 16 March 2026 to fell a copper beech at Eppendorfer Stieg 7. The letter is dated 30 April 2026 and allows an objection (Widerspruch).
data.explanation: The district office refused permission to fell the beech because it is protected under the tree protection ordinance (Baumschutzverordnung). It found the tree healthy and stable, and said the shading of your balcony is not an unreasonable burden. You may decide to file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the office. The app shows the deadline. If you do nothing, the refusal becomes final. Do not fell the tree without a permit. Consider getting advice if you want to challenge the decision.

items.title: Objection against refusal
items.action: If you want to contest the refusal, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person with the Bezirksamt Musterbek.
items.consequence: The refusal becomes final if no objection is filed in time.
